nodes.title: Objective Mutual Assent
nodes.conceptSummary:
### 1. Pangkal Anomali
Kita sering mengira kesepakatan hukum didasarkan pada kesamaan isi pikiran batiniah (subjective meeting of minds). Pendekatan ini runtuh seketika saat salah satu pihak menandatangani kontrak jual beli tanah resmi lalu berdalih bahwa ia hanya bercanda di dalam hati (seperti dalam kasus landmark Lucy v. Zehmer). Pengadilan tidak dapat membaca isi tengkorak kepala manusia.

### 2. Prototipe Intuitif
Bayangkan cermin pantulan di kasir toko. Cermin hanya merekam gerakan fisik tangan yang menyerahkan barang dan menandatangani kertas tanda terima. Cermin tidak bisa menangkap keraguan atau lelucon rahasia di dalam pikiran orang tersebut.

### 3. Invarian & Operasi Inti
Invarian mutlak sistem adalah **Teori Objektif Perjanjian**: keabsahan kesepakatan diukur dari manifestasi lahiriah yang dapat ditangkap oleh orang wajar (reasonable person), bukan niat subjektif rahasia.

forwardPass.prompt: "Predict contract enforceability if Party A writes and signs a formal land sale contract but secretly considers it an elaborate practical joke."

options.text: The contract is binding under the objective theory of contracts: assent is judged by a reasonable person's outward manifestation, not hidden subjective intent (Lucy v. Zehmer).
options.causalRationale: Correct: Outward objective manifestation binds the parties regardless of secret subjective intent.

options.text: The contract is void because subjective mutual assent (meeting of minds) was absent during signing.
options.causalRationale: Subjective Fallacy: Law discarded subjective intent in favor of outward reasonable manifestation.

options.text: The contract is unenforceable because contracts signed in social settings are per se invalid.
options.causalRationale: Setting Irrelevance: Location does not invalidate an otherwise formal written offer and acceptance.
